title: Frontend: Frequently Asked Questions
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Frequently Asked Questions. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App({items=[]}). Controlled Search input filters title or body case-insensitively. Each visible item {id,title,body} has a button toggling its answer region #answer-ID. Multiple may stay expanded; filtering must retain expansion IDs. Empty results show No matching answers.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Represent FAQ items by stable IDs and derive matches from normalized question/body text.
alternativeApproaches: Group results by category while avoiding duplicate IDs in accessibility relationships.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Search body text; no matches; clear search.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
